en-US.description: hiro is a personal test build with customizable on-screen presentation, viewing protection and device connectivity.
en-US.whats_new: Added an optional native short timer for supported devices, updated the lifetime display, and refined automatic mode handling near the end of a session.

zh-Hans.description: hiro 是用于个人测试的应用版本，提供可自定义的界面展示、查看保护和设备连接功能。
zh-Hans.whats_new: 新增可选的设备原生短时定时，更新使用期限显示，调整会话末段的自动模式处理。
